entries.candidate: CoreSite SV1 (55 S. Market St., San Jose) and SV2 (1656 McCarthy Blvd., Milpitas), Santa Clara County
entries.reason: CoreSite's market page (sitemap lastmod 9 October 2026; Internet Archive copy of 11 October 2026 with the same text) lists SV1 at 55 S. Market St., San Jose (320,000+ sq ft) and SV2 at 1656 McCarthy Blvd., Milpitas (76,000+ sq ft) as part of its Silicon Valley campus. CoreSite's 1 September 2026 OCI FastConnect release names only that multi-city campus, not SV1 or SV2, and the verifier (worker 1) found that it does not observe the status of any named building (see the Santa Clara campus hold). Both are separate properties outside the Santa Clara cluster. No county parcel was queried for either.

entries.candidate: CoreSite Silicon Valley Santa Clara Campus (SV3 to SV9; SV4 2972 Stender Way, SV7 3020 Coronado Dr, SV8 3035 Stender Way and SV9 2915 Stender Way, Santa Clara)
entries.reason: Proposed as a new site by this fragment and removed by the verifier (worker 1, 27 October 2026). The status source, CoreSite's release of 1 September 2026, says CoreSite 'will offer' a new OCI FastConnect on-ramp 'at CoreSite's Silicon Valley data center campus' without naming the building that hosts it; its 'now provides' sentence speaks of CoreSite's connectivity to four US OCI regions in general. CoreSite's market page and its 30 July 2025 SV9 release define that Silicon Valley campus as nine data centres spanning Milpitas, San Jose and Santa Clara, including SV1 (San Jose) and SV2 (Milpitas), which this addition excluded. The release therefore observes neither the Santa Clara campus nor any of its buildings and cannot carry an operational status for a Santa Clara project; the sixty-eighth hold (q3-us-reits-p3) read it the same way. SV3, SV5 and SV6, named only on the SV4 page (sitemap lastmod April 2026), are also absent from the current market page's facility list. Identity and locator were otherwise confirmed: the four county parcels 216-29-123, 216-46-021, 216-29-084 and 216-29-108 and their union centroid (-121.9710987, 37.3761468), inside 216-29-123, were recomputed from the capture (EPSG 32610, 5070 and 3310 agree within 0.01 m). Not an Atlas record.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated CoreSite statement within 85 days of an update that names a Santa Clara facility (SV4, SV7, SV8 or SV9) or the Santa Clara campus as operating: a release, an American Tower results supplement, or a facility or market page version bounded by an archived copy. The market page version of 9 October 2026 (bounded below by the 13 July 2026 copy, which still carried an SV9 'scheduled to open' FAQ, and matched byte for byte by the 11 October copy) may qualify but was not proposed or reviewed as a status source. Then reuse the county parcel-union locator recorded here and scope the project to the named buildings.

AVAIO's page also says it 'has broken ground on Project Leo' and that the site 'has a fully approved Site Plan', but neither statement is dated or tied to a recorded approval or works record.
